answer: Each identity books one work slot on a ridge crew and locks 70 credits. Each epoch it works one dune shift and files a key-signed record with a vine serial. Auditors recompute the roster: a missed shift, reused serial, or shared slot burns the deposit. Slot k costs 35+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 plus 70,000 locked; a rented-crew ring fails: each vine serial binds one key. An honest agent pays 35 once and keeps its deposit.
